subject: Rank..
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
Unfortunately, that coveted #1 spot doesnt belong to the best racer as 95% of the names you are seeing on the ranking are all slow racers who are easy to pass and takedown...

There are in reality two rankings system. The listed and the unlisted.. The listed one that people see on the scoreboards are full of cheaters who are slow and cant race. The unlisted one is the truth under that veil of wannabe players, which consists of only 20 people who are the best, fastest, most consistent, and can hold their boost much better than other people.....

-------------------------------------------

"Remember tonight... for it is the beginning of always."
